editorial.summary: A 3:49 rapid multi-speaker JRE #1965 excerpt about a pandemic-era celebrity offshoot, a later reported Jeff Probst invitation to actual Survivor, and an extensive casting process. The narrator preserves harsh washed-up/body/wealth language, getting in shape, fear that recognition would cause elimination, therapist screening for violence/self-harm, and a reported request to pay to erase an inappropriate online footprint. A Chris Rock first-pitch deletion rumor is immediately qualified and undermined when footage is found; Anthony Fauci’s pitch is mocked. The narrator ends by claiming he would have won because a history of gaslighting, lying, con artistry, theft and sneakiness prepared him. Names/titles are repaired, but no final offer/casting, CBS rule, therapist finding, deletion/payment, crime or voice is invented.
